title: Jaate Ho Ali Akbar Jaate Ho Ali Akbar
body:
Jaate Ho Ali Akbar Jaate Ho Ali Akbar
Kehti Hai Dukya Madar
Dil ko qarar bata
Kaise mere rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho mere hil ki Dhadkan
Jeekar karon kya tum bin
Na jao mere Dilbar
Qismat kahan ye layi
<<DIVIDER>>
Dulha naba na payi
Dil ki mere sada hai
Ek majlis-e-aza hai
Chalta hai dilpa khanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
Athara saal pali
Ye dukya maa bhi teri
Zainab ke dil se pucho
Ek ilteja bhi sunlo
<<DIVIDER>>
Seene se dil hai bahar
Abbas bhi sidare
Hai kaun ab hamare
Jo laye humko pani
<<DIVIDER>>
Bathlao mere jani
Bhara hai manzar
sunte nahi ho maa ki
Sunta hai jab khuda ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya maa ko phal mila hai
Dil mera jal raha hia
Sun kar sadaye sarwar
